name: Evalezy
target_customers: schools, coaching institutes, UPSC/PSC programmes, colleges, exam bodies, edtech platforms (API)

entry_price.notes: $0.01 per page outside India; failed, stopped and unreadable copies free; excl. GST

handwritten_reading.evidence: Reads scanned or phone-photographed handwritten copies (PDF)

subjective_ai_marking.evidence: Marks every answer against a marking scheme per question

stem_maths.evidence: Reads maths working; unsure equation lines get a second read by an equation reader. Diagrams judged by labels only

rubric_marking_scheme.evidence: AI-drafted or teacher-written criteria per question that add up to the marks; model answers

partial_marks_feedback.evidence: Half-mark steps with a written reason per question and criteria breakdown

typed_answers.evidence: Grades typed long answers (essays, letters, emails) from online tests

indian_languages.evidence: English answers only; Hindi/regional copies fail with language_not_supported (not charged)

bulk_scan_ingest.evidence: Up to 200 PDFs per upload in the dashboard; API uploads up to 100 PDFs per call

student_identification.evidence: Reads name, roll number and class from the top of page 1 and matches to the class list; never guesses

annotated_copy.evidence: Returns the student's own copy checked in a handwriting-style red pen with marks and notes

teacher_review.evidence: AI marks are drafts; teacher reviews, overrides and releases (dashboard) or finalizes (API)

question_paper_import.evidence: Upload the question paper and it is read into questions with marks (dashboard)

public_api.evidence: Evaluation API v1 live since 2 Oct 2026, docs at docs.evalezy.com

integrity_checks.evidence: No plagiarism or AI-writing detection on answers today

notable_2025_2026: Launched the Evaluation API (v1) on 2 October 2026.
